hooks.text: NASA is racing across deep space to hunt down eight separate asteroids.
One spacecraft is flying twelve years to explore eight different asteroids.
A NASA probe named after a fossil is carrying diamonds into space.

title: NASA's 12-Year Hunt for Eight Asteroids
description: NASA's Lucy spacecraft is on a twelve-year journey to explore eight separate asteroids across deep space.

beats.text: NASA is racing across deep space to hunt down eight separate asteroids.
beats.visual: Artist concept of NASA Lucy spacecraft in deep space, 2021

beats.text: Launched on October 16, 2021, the 981 million dollar Lucy spacecraft began an ambitious twelve-year voyage.
beats.visual: Atlas V rocket launch carrying Lucy spacecraft, 2021

beats.text: Named after famous hominin fossils, the probe actually carries a disc made of lab-grown diamonds for its instruments.
beats.visual: Reconstruction of the Lucy hominin fossil skeleton

beats.text: Lucy is traveling to visit six Jupiter trojan asteroids sharing the giant planet's orbit, alongside two main belt asteroids.
beats.visual: Diagram of Jupiter Trojan asteroids in Lagrange orbits

beats.text: In November 2023, principal investigator Harold Levison guided the spacecraft past the asteroid [Dinkinesh](/dˈɪnkˈɪnˈɛʃ/).
beats.visual: Asteroid Dinkinesh and satellite captured by Lucy probe, 2023

beats.text: Cameras revealed its moon was actually two asteroids fused together.
beats.visual: NASA close-up image of Dinkinesh contact binary satellite, 2023

beats.text: After another flyby past asteroid [Donaldjohanson](/dˈɑnˈɔldʤˈOhˈænsˈʌn/) in April 2025, the probe heads toward the outer swarms.
beats.visual: Main-belt asteroid Donaldjohanson photographed by Lucy spacecraft, 2025

beats.text: That bizarre contact binary was just the first stop of this epic twelve-year trek.
beats.visual: Artist concept of Lucy spacecraft cruising through deep space, 2021
